name: TouchSurface
summary:
**Your desk is now a touchscreen.**

TouchSurface is a mixed reality workspace for Meta Quest 3 and 3S that turns any flat surface into a touchscreen. Rest your hands on a table and a glass window appears right under your fingers. Tap, draw, scroll and play on something solid: you feel every touch, and your arms can rest.
